verdict.rationale: Mangopay is fundamentally an API/SDK platform (Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java, Ruby SDKs plus a documented Sandbox API and OpenAPI spec), meaning all core functionality is scriptable and callable without any UI — inherently suited to headless/CI use, and the Sandbox with test cards supports automated testing pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running it inside a CI/CD pipeline, automated test suites, or headless invocation patterns beyond the SDK/API references. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, automation/test-runner integration guides, and independent evidence of real-world CI usage.
